critical_code_review_comments: Rate limit is in-memory per-process (_rate_limit_ip dict). In multi-worker/uvicorn or K8s multi-replica deploys this allows up to N*limit req/min globally. Fine for single-instance preview; move to Redis for production.

Public endpoints are rate-limited by X-Forwarded-For/client.host — behind K8s ingress all requests may share the ingress IP, so a single misbehaving client cannot be isolated from a benign one on the same egress IP. Consider also rate-limiting by ticket code for /public/track/*/messages.

@page { size: A4 portrait } is defined at top-level globally, so even thermal-label and lowstock prints will inherit A4 portrait size unless the printer driver overrides. Consider conditional @page rules via html.print-mode-label (but note @page cannot be nested — would need separate print.css loaded dynamically) or document that users must select label-roll size in print dialog.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 6 fully green. Print bug ROOT CAUSE was previous CSS used `html.print-mode-a4 @page {}` (invalid nested @page) + fragile visibility:hidden toggling that broke the layout. FIX applied: @page at top level + display:none on body>*:not(.print-root-*) + per-mode class guards html:not(.print-mode-X) .print-root-X {display:none}. To verify print output is NOT blank you MUST use await page.emulate_media(media='print') then check computed style of .print-root-X (display=block, color=rgb(0,0,0)) and verify all other body>* children are display=none. offsetHeight may be 0 in headless Playwright under emulate_media because mm units with position:static don't fully layout at screen viewport — this does NOT indicate blank print; verify by DOM presence + computed display/color. For rate-limit tests, hit http://0.0.0.0:8001 directly (K8s ingress rotates source IP) — see TestSEC001::test_public_rate_limit_200_then_429 and TestSEC003::test_public_chat_rate_limit for reference.
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE of 'foglio bianco' (blank print preview): (a) prior CSS tried to put @page { size: A4 } inside `html.print-mode-a4 { ... }` which is invalid — @page is a top-level at-rule and the whole block was ignored by the browser, resulting in no page size + the body visibility toggle leaving the real print root at left:-10000px fixed. (b) `visibility:hidden/visible` toggling kept DOM space but Chrome's print engine computed zero paintable area for the fixed-position root when its visibility was coerced. FIX: moved @page to top-level, changed to display:none-based isolation (body>*:not(.print-root-*)) and reset position/left/top/display inside @media print for the active print-root. VERIFIED under page.emulate_media('print'): .print-root-a4 computed display=block color=rgb(0,0,0), text content 'COPIA CLIENTE'+'COPIA LABORATORIO' present, all other body children display=none. Same pattern verified for label std/mini/banco and lowstock.
